name: com.wagenheimer.ratecontrol
description: Cross-platform rate/review prompt system for Unity games. Supports Google Play In-App Review, Apple SKStoreReviewManager, Steam, Mac App Store, and Amazon. Drop-in default UI with full customization support.

defines.description: Uses the Google Play In-App Review API for the rate prompt. Automatic inside the RateControl assembly when com.google.play.review is installed.
